items.title: Continuity of an integral with a moving observable and law
items.statement: Let T be a topological parameter space and X a compact topological space with a measurable structure in which open sets are measurable. If F:T×X→ℝ is jointly continuous and t↦μ_t is a continuous curve of probability measures in the weak topology, then t↦∫F(t,x) μ_t(dx) is continuous.
assumptions: The parameter space is topological. The compact topological state space has measurable open sets.
The real observable F is jointly continuous, and t↦μ_t is continuous in the weak topology of probability measures.
